short: The signed-in area behind the session gate
is: The signed-in area — a group layout that bounces anonymous visitors to `/login` and wraps every page in the Explorer frame, containing the account screens and the logout action; its errors render inside the frame.
conventions: The sign-in gate is the server `handle` hook (`lib/server/session-gate.ts`): no `(session)` load, data request (whatever loads it asks to skip) or form action runs without a session. The group layout's redirect only narrows the type. The backend still checks the session on every call.
New signed-in routes JOIN this group rather than re-implementing the check.
Detail pages derive from the caller's own listing — there is no fetch-by-id rpc in v1; destructive actions require typed confirmation (WCAG 3.3.4).
Each page's load returns `trail` (App.PageData) for the frame's path bar; the frame itself reads nothing from the backend.

fs.name: +error.svelte
fs.role: errors inside the frame, by status and route alone (ErrorView) — a failed sign-out says so; the error's message is never read

fs.name: +layout.server.ts
fs.role: hands the frame the session (the hook already refused anyone without one; the redirect here only narrows the type)

fs.name: +layout.svelte
fs.role: the Explorer frame (AppShell) around every signed-in page: the path from the page's `trail`, the drawer closed after each navigation; the sidebar stays empty until My Den's tree arrives

fs.name: accounts/
fs.role: listing + create action; [id]/ detail with typed-handle delete confirmation

fs.name: error.svelte.spec.ts
fs.role: proves the in-frame error page never shows the error's message and that a failed sign-out says so ($app/state mocked)

fs.name: layout.server.spec.ts
fs.role: spec for the gate — anonymous redirects, signed-in passes the session through

fs.name: layout.svelte.spec.ts
fs.role: the frame around a signed-in page with real styles ($app/state and afterNavigate mocked): banner + main + path, Accounts current, Sign out in the top bar, skip link first, drawer closes on navigation, one Accounts in the drawer, no sideways scroll at 320 px

fs.name: logout/
fs.role: an action, not a page — a stray GET goes home

notes: See also: internal ruling "F1" — no `GetAccount` rpc in v1, account detail derives from the caller's own account listing (cited in `accounts/[id]/+page.server.ts`); not yet a recorded DD, ask the Engineer if this should become one.
